purpose: Test whether the next-task recommendation exposure divergence caused by V7 action writeback produces a second categorical LLM-agent choice divergence.
studyRole: Confirmatory final link in a one-step recommendation-order to agent-choice to recommender-exposure to later-agent-choice chain.
claimBoundary: The study concerns provider outputs over pseudonymous derived features in a research storefront. It does not establish human behavior, purchases, production-retailer effects, long-run amplification, or welfare consequences.

sampling.frame: All 460 frozen tasks crossed with SASRec and GRU4Rec; no conditioning on current-choice or next-slate divergence.
sampling.dependence: Resample tasks within category, retaining both recommender families in each task cluster.

decisionInstrument.controlSelection: Include a task-model unit when the first 64 bits of sha256(category/taskId/modelFamily/downstream-control), interpreted as an integer, are divisible by four.
decisionInstrument.controlState: Repeat the immediate-a next-task state byte-for-byte under all four condition labels; cache scopes remain distinct.
decisionInstrument.nextTaskProxy: The held-out chronological next item defines a private token-overlap and price-similarity intent proxy. Titles, tokens, raw item IDs, and the held-out item are never sent.
decisionInstrument.candidateOrder: Use the actual next slate emitted after each V7 selected action was written back; do not send an explicit platform-rank field.
decisionInstrument.hardConstraint: A selectable candidate must share at least one non-stopword title token with the held-out next item; abandon is valid if none do.

estimand.name: categorical energy distance
estimand.formula: 2 * mean(immediate != held over four cross-arm pairs) - 1[immediate-a != immediate-b] - 1[held-a != held-b]
estimand.primary: DeepSeek downstream categorical action distance over all 920 primary units.
estimand.negativeControl: DeepSeek categorical distance in the independently selected byte-identical control subset.

confirmatoryGate.prerequisite: The frozen feedback-exposure gate is true before calls begin.
confirmatoryGate.primary: Downstream-action lower 95% bound is above zero.
confirmatoryGate.reliability: Primary and control protocol failure rates are each below 0.05.
confirmatoryGate.recurrence: SASRec and GRU4Rec primary point estimates are both above zero.
confirmatoryGate.decision: All five requirements must pass to claim a measurable one-step agent-recommender-agent feedback path.

stopRules.nullDownstreamAction: If the primary lower bound is not above zero, retain only the recommendation-exposure feedback result and do not claim later behavioral propagation.
stopRules.unstableControl: If the control upper bound is at least 0.05, attribute the result to unresolved provider variability and do not claim the final link.
stopRules.modelSpecific: If either recommender-family point estimate is non-positive, describe the final link as model-dependent.
